FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Guardian Investigative Services specializes in providing unarmed security guard services for commercial office buildings and retail establishments, ensuring all personnel are properly licensed and certified in accordance with local and state regulations. Our operations are focused on maintaining a secure environment for our clients while implementing comprehensive risk management strategies. We also engage in private investigations, offering background checks and surveillance services tailored for corporate clients, emphasizing minimal physical risk exposure. Our commitment to security extends to risk assessments and security audits, providing consulting services to help entities improve their safety protocols without direct involvement in physical security operations. We ensure compliance with industry regulations while striving to reduce liability and enhance the safety of the environments we serve.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Security Consulting Group, LLC - providing risk assessment and security audits for various clients without direct involvement in physical security operations.
